pages.text: Machines draw power in $(bold)kW$(). Stored energy is $(bold)kJ$(): a full 500 kJ cell runs 5 kW for 100 seconds.

pages.title: Sources
pages.text: $(li)$(l:advanced/core_upgrades)Geothermal Core$(/l) power share: up to $(bold)20 kW$()$(li)$(l:reactor/overview)Hearthstone Reactor$(/l)$(li)Charged $(l:power/storage)Power Cells$(/l)

pages.title: Links
pages.text: The $(l:power/binder)Conduit Binder$(/l) draws cyan links between the Core, relays, feedthroughs and machines.$(br2)Everything joined by links is one network.

pages.title: Who Gets Power
pages.text: Supply is shared out every second, in order:$(li)$(bold)Oxygen$(): PIXIE-2$(li)$(bold)Heat$(): RH-5$(li)$(bold)Everything else$(): lights, furnaces$(br2)Spare power charges batteries.

pages.title: Brownouts
pages.text: When supply falls short, machines switch off whole, lowest priority first.$(br2)Batteries cover the gap until they drain. A $(l:power/monitor)Power Monitor$(/l) lists what's waiting.

pages.title: Sealed Walls
pages.text: A link can't cross a sealed room's wall except through a $(l:power/relays)Bulkhead Feedthrough$(/l).$(br2)Other blocks don't block links.
